blockerSummary: OANDA archive bounded production proof and restore proof are ready; Investing storage proof is ready; Khashi storage pressure is cleared by Docker build-cache maintenance proof. Remaining watch items are Khashi restore proof, approval-gated OANDA archive/prune execution, and keeping destructive pruning disabled until all gates pass.

projects.role: fleet visibility and operator control plane

gates.ready: Collectors/workers are running, restart deltas are low, and expected datasets refresh within cadence.
gates.watch: Some collectors are stale or restarting, but durable writes continue and alerts are visible.
gates.blocked: A required collector is stopped, OOM killed, or producing no fresh rows.

gates.ready: Production disk is below 75% used or forecast remains outside the 30-day/14-day danger windows.
gates.watch: Production disk is 75-85% used or runway forecast is uncertain.
gates.blocked: Production disk is above 85% used without verified retention/export proof.

gates.ready: Archive bundles have manifests, checksums, row/file counts, and restore proof.
gates.watch: Archive bundles exist but restore proof or catalog coverage is incomplete.
gates.blocked: Archive bundles are missing, incomplete, too memory-heavy to reproduce, or fail verification.

gates.ready: External mirror is mounted in the production context, writable, cataloged, and verified.
gates.watch: Mirror exists locally but production mount/writeability is not proven.
gates.blocked: Mirror root is missing, not mounted in production, or no verified bundles exist.

gates.ready: At least one current archive and database backup has been restored into staging or an isolated verification target.
gates.watch: Backup/archive artifacts exist but restore rehearsal is stale.
gates.blocked: No restore proof exists for data that would be pruned or trusted as durable.

gates.ready: Nous shows warehouse growth, freshness, retention, mirror, archive, restore, and failed collector status.
gates.watch: Some facts are visible but drilldown or action history is incomplete.
gates.blocked: Operators cannot tell whether data is fresh, mirrored, restorable, or safe to prune.

minimumWaveOneExit: OANDA archive proof and remaining prune/live gates are explicitly represented
Khashi data-ops implementation lane points at CP-04
destructive pruning remains disabled unless archive, backup, restore, and approval gates pass
